entities.title: Agent-facing design resource sources in this stream
entities.description: Ten official project/protocol URLs read as text for candidate identification, design-system and workflow formats, component distribution, and agent integration routes. Corpus membership is discovery context, not evidence that every entity implements every described capability.

entities.title: nexu-io/open-design od-design-system-project/v1 package shape
entities.description: Exact repository and package contract exemplar: minimum paths manifest.json, DESIGN.md, tokens.css; the README's illustrative manifest schema uses id acme. This is a documented format example, not an inspected installed package or a claim about a particular brand system.

entities.title: OpenDesign skill protocol distinction between skills/ and design-templates/
entities.description: Specific project taxonomy example: functional skills and rendering design templates can both use SKILL.md but have separate directories, registries, and APIs. Source is the official protocol text; no runtime was executed.

entities.title: MCP tools/list and tools/call protocol example
entities.description: Protocol-level retrieval and invocation sequence with inputSchema; not a tested MCP server or client approval UI.

entities.title: Agent Skills SKILL.md portable instruction format
entities.description: Text-based workflow instruction format with optional references/assets/scripts and progressive disclosure. Client support and script execution are implementation-specific.

entities.title: MCP server tool surface
entities.description: Protocol substrate for discovering schema-described tools and invoking them, including optional design-source reads or writes. Tool permissions depend on server, client, account, and user approvals.

entities.title: shadcn/ui registry distribution system
entities.description: Officially documented custom registry for distributing components, hooks, pages, config, rules, and other files. Schema and install behavior not read in this stream.

entities.title: Figma MCP server and design file context/write tools
entities.description: Officially documented remote or desktop server connection for selected clients, with design context extraction and native canvas write workflows. Not connected or tested here.

entities.title: OpenDesign product at open-design.ai / nexu-io/open-design
entities.description: Primary technical research exemplar selected because official product site links to the repository and repository documents provide detailed formats and integration boundaries. This selection does not establish that the user intended this project.

entities.title: Open Design product at opendesigner.io
entities.description: Distinct same-name product candidate according to its own product page. Repository identity was not traced; its product claims remain isolated and are not attributed to nexu-io/open-design.
